summary: Plan session handoff orchestration stabilization for TASK-006

assumptions: Pi lacks a current portable terminal-tab API; TASK-006 should document this and implement the best current adapter-managed fallback, not fake a new tab.
The compatibility command may remain registered internally because command context is the documented Pi path for ctx.newSession.
non_goals: Do not implement a terminal-specific launcher without explicit design/config.
Do not build full vNext decision/work/gate tool consolidation under TASK-006.
Do not bypass validation/content proof requirements.
risks: Queued internal slash command may still be visible in Pi transcript because Pi command context currently requires a slash command vehicle; hiding it completely may need upstream Pi support or a worker-process adapter.
